title: OrgGraph canonical type registry
description: Curated, versioned type registry (PRD FR-4.1). Declares node and edge types with declarative capabilities; the app engine itself is type-agnostic (PRD FR-4.2, NFR-5). Dataset schemas in snapshots are subsets of this registry (PRD FR-3.4).

version.description: Registry version stamp; copied into snapshot meta.registryVersion (PRD FR-6.1b).

nodeTypes.description: Node type name -> capabilities. Names are data, never referenced in engine code (PRD NFR-5); they must be path-safe identifiers so every type is addressable in view path expressions (PRD E58).

edgeTypes.description: Edge type name -> declaration. Names must be path-safe identifiers (PRD E58).

labelProp.description: Path resolved as display name: "label" or a scalar props path like "props.displayName" (PRD FR-4.2b). If absent, "label" applies; if it resolves to a missing or non-scalar value, display falls back to "label" and the import warns.

identifiers.description: Searchable/matchable identifier paths, e.g. "id" or "props.email" (search, import matching).

leafProp.description: Boolean property marking leaf nodes; drives the type-agnostic leaf filter (PRD FR-8.3).

pool.description: Name of the pseudonym pool in the tenant's pseudo data.

byLevel.description: Pick pool entries by BFS level (PRD FR-8.5).

pseudonymize.description: Selects the nicer, type-specific pseudonym pool. Types WITHOUT this capability still get the deterministic fail-closed fallback "<Typname> N" when pseudonymization is active (PRD E48, FR-8.5). Presentation (colors, icons) is intentionally NOT part of the registry (PRD FR-4.2a / E13).

props.description: Optional declarations for node-type props; implies is edge-only (PRD E63).

identityProps.description: Props that are part of the edge identity in addition to type+source+target (PRD FR-5.2 / E15); typically reference props such as "kontext".

propDecls.description: Declarations for individual props. Every props key used by snapshots MUST be declared here (minimal decl: {}); the import rejects used keys unknown to the tenant registry — the registry is the single source of truth down to field level (PRD FR-4.5, FR-3.4, FR-6.8).

type.description: Scalar type hint; import validation warns on mismatch, never silently drops.

ref.description: Node type this prop references; the value is a node id (PRD FR-4.7). The only exception to the scalar principle.

implies.description: Edge type derived from this reference as a PROJECTION contribution (PRD FR-4.8, E33, E52): the base edge's validity is the union of the intervals of ALL primary facts implying the same identity (plus any directly delivered contribution) — never a one-to-one interval copy, never an independent closure candidate; it ends only when no valid primary fact implies it anymore. Requires ref.

nonSensitive.description: Whitelist flag for pseudo mode (PRD E60): only props marked nonSensitive stay visible in tooltips, search results, legends, reference labels, and exports while pseudonymization is active.

not.$comment: A reference prop holds a node id; combining ref with a scalar type hint is contradictory.
